# Task
<goal>

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `<argv を空白連結>` exits <expectExit> (cwd: <cwd>)
- [ ] <anchor の describe>

- <constraint>

## References
- <ref>

---
kind: knowledge
id: auth.session-store
claim: fact
anchors:
  - { kind: path, pattern: "workspace://app/src/auth/session-store.ts", expect: exists }
---
セッションは Redis に保存され、TTL は 24 時間。

plan     = host.plan(tree, ctx)
log 'render/intent' {host, plan.digest}
observed = host.observe(plan)
last     = CommitRecord(workspace, host) or null
for each target T in plan ∪ last:
  o = observed[T], l = last[T], p = plan[T]
  if l != null and o == null and p == null: → remove T from CommitRecord (D-071)
  elif l == null and o != null:           → TARGET_OCCUPIED（全体失敗。import を提案）
  elif l != null and o != l.digest:       → drift/detected、T は skip（I-HOST-2）
  elif p != null and p.digest != o:     → 書く
  elif p == null and l != null:         → 削除（自分の生成物のみ）
write CommitRecord（skip した T は旧 digest を保持）
log 'render/committed' or 'render/failed'

┌──────────── @reins/core（DSH 非依存・純粋）────────────┐
            │ refs / caps / elaborate / projections / log / task-compile │
            └───────────────┬──────────────────────┬──────────────────┘
                            │                      │
        driver A: @reins/cli（単体）      driver B: dsh-plugin-reins（Cordis plugin）
        静的ホスト（agents-md /          動的ホスト dsh、DSH ログ橋渡し、
        claude-code / codex）、           session_* ツール、ctx.subagents 連携、
        tmux セッションホスト             ガードによる権限強制

[tools]
node = "22"
pnpm = "10"
tmux = "latest"          # Required for S-4; pin the version in M0.
"npm:@deepseek-ai/dsh" = "<M0 で固定>"
"npm:@anthropic-ai/claude-code" = "<M0 で固定>"
"npm:@openai/codex" = "<M0 で固定>"

[tasks.build]
run = "pnpm -r build"
[tasks.test]
run = "pnpm -r test"
[tasks.invariants]
run = "pnpm -r test -- --testNamePattern '^I-'"
[tasks.contracts]
run = "pnpm --filter dsh-contracts test"
[tasks."dsh:candidate"]
run = "node scripts/dsh-candidate.mjs"   # Argument: candidate version.
[tasks.lint]
run = "pnpm -r lint"
